Definition: from G3598 and G2233; a conductor (literally or figuratively (teacher)):--guide, leader.
BiblicalUsage: hodēgós is the word for guide, leader. I meet it 5 times across the Bible, and Matthew is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hodēgós matters because God guides His people; He does not leave them to find their own way. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
